description: List leagues for a sport with name, slug and active event count. Call get_sports first for the sport slug; use the league slug in get_events and other tools.

all.description: If true, include leagues without active events

fields.description: Optional comma-separated top-level fields to keep on each item (e.g. 'id,home,away,date,status'). Trims large responses.

maxResults.description: Optional cap on the number of items returned to you (applied after the API call).

name: get_leagues
title: List leagues
